description: This file defines the ClientEntity class in the SuiteCRM OAuth2 API, implementing the ClientEntityInterface and including traits for client and entity behavior. It provides setter methods for client name, redirect URI, and confidentiality status.

classes.name: ClientEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 client entity with properties for name, redirect URI, and confidentiality.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the client.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the client.

methods.name: setIsConfidential
methods.description: Sets whether the client is confidential.
